with dates as (
    select
        dateadd(
            day,
            row_number() over (order by seq4()) - 1,
            '2016-01-01'::date
        )::date as date_day
    from table(generator(rowcount => 5479))
)

select
    to_number(to_char(date_day, 'YYYYMMDD')) as date_key,
    date_day,
    year(date_day) as calendar_year,
    quarter(date_day) as calendar_quarter,
    month(date_day) as month_number,
    monthname(date_day) as month_name,
    date_trunc('month', date_day)::date as month_start,
    day(date_day) as day_of_month,
    dayofweekiso(date_day) as weekday_number,
    dayofweekiso(date_day) in (6, 7) as is_weekend
from dates

with source_data as (
    select *
    from OLIST.RAW.customers
),

ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by nullif(trim(customer_id), '')
            order by
                batch_seq desc,
                source_filename desc,
                source_row_number desc
        ) as row_rank
    from source_data
)

select
    nullif(trim(customer_id), '') as customer_id,
    nullif(trim(customer_unique_id), '') as customer_unique_id,
    nullif(trim(customer_zip_code_prefix), '') as customer_zip_code_prefix,
    lower(nullif(trim(customer_city), '')) as customer_city,
    upper(nullif(trim(customer_state), '')) as customer_state,
    ingested_at,
    source_filename,
    source_row_number,
    batch_id,
    batch_seq
from ranked
where row_rank = 1

with typed as (
    select
        nullif(trim(order_id), '') as order_id,
        try_to_decimal(
            nullif(trim(order_item_id), ''), 18, 0
        ) as order_item_id,
        nullif(trim(product_id), '') as product_id,
        nullif(trim(seller_id), '') as seller_id,
        try_to_timestamp_ntz(
            nullif(trim(shipping_limit_date), '')
        ) as shipping_limit_date,
        try_to_decimal(
            nullif(trim(price), ''), 18, 2
        ) as merchandise_value,
        try_to_decimal(
            nullif(trim(freight_value), ''), 18, 2
        ) as freight_value,
        ingested_at,
        source_filename,
        source_row_number,
        batch_id,
        batch_seq
    from OLIST.RAW.order_items
),

ranked as (
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (
            partition by order_id, order_item_id
            order by
                batch_seq desc,
                source_filename desc,
                source_row_number desc

select
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_status,
    to_number(
        to_char(order_purchase_timestamp::date, 'YYYYMMDD')
    ) as purchase_date_key,
    order_purchase_timestamp,
    order_approved_at,
    order_delivered_carrier_date,
    order_delivered_customer_date,
    order_estimated_delivery_date,

    order_status = 'delivered' as is_delivered,

    case
        when order_status = 'delivered'
             and order_delivered_customer_date is not null
             and order_estimated_delivery_date is not null
        then order_delivered_customer_date::date
             > order_estimated_delivery_date::date
        else null
    end as is_late,

    case
        when order_status = 'delivered'
             and order_delivered_customer_date is not null
        then datediff(
            'day',
            order_purchase_timestamp::date,
            order_delivered_customer_date::date
        )
        else null
    end as delivery_days,

    batch_id,
    batch_seq
from OLIST.STAGING.stg_orders as src


where not exists (
    select 1
    from OLIST.CORE.fct_orders as existing
    where existing.order_id = src.order_id
          and existing.batch_seq >= src.batch_seq
)

select
    c.customer_unique_id,
    count(*) as delivered_orders,
    min(o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date as first_purchase_date,
    max(o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date as latest_purchase_date,
    count(*) >= 2 as is_repeat_customer
from OLIST.CORE.fct_orders o
join OLIST.CORE.dim_customers c
    on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
where o.is_delivered
group by c.customer_unique_id

with monthly as (
    select
        date_trunc(
            'month', order_purchase_timestamp
        )::date as purchase_month,
        count(*) as delivered_orders,
        sum(case when is_late is not null then 1 else 0 end)
            as measurable_orders,
        sum(case when is_late then 1 else 0 end)
            as late_orders,
        sum(case when is_late is null then 1 else 0 end)
            as missing_delivery_dates,
        avg(delivery_days) as average_delivery_days
    from OLIST.CORE.fct_orders
    where is_delivered
    group by 1
)

select
    *,
    round(
        100.0 * late_orders / nullif(measurable_orders, 0),
        2
    ) as late_order_percentage
from monthly

select
    date_trunc(
        'month', o.order_purchase_timestamp
    )::date as purchase_month,
    count(distinct o.order_id) as delivered_orders,
    count(*) as delivered_items,
    sum(i.merchandise_value) as merchandise_value,
    sum(i.freight_value) as freight_value,
    sum(i.total_item_value) as total_item_value
from OLIST.CORE.fct_orders o
join OLIST.CORE.fct_order_items i
    on o.order_id = i.order_id
where o.is_delivered
group by 1

select
    date_trunc(
        'month', o.order_purchase_timestamp
    )::date as purchase_month,
    c.customer_state,
    count(distinct o.order_id) as delivered_orders,
    count(*) as delivered_items,
    sum(i.merchandise_value) as merchandise_value,
    sum(i.freight_value) as freight_value,
    sum(i.total_item_value) as total_item_value
from OLIST.CORE.fct_orders o
join OLIST.CORE.fct_order_items i
    on o.order_id = i.order_id
join OLIST.CORE.dim_customers c
    on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
where o.is_delivered
group by 1, 2

select
    p.product_id,
    p.product_category_name,
    count(distinct o.order_id) as delivered_orders,
    count(*) as delivered_items,
    sum(i.merchandise_value) as merchandise_value,
    sum(i.freight_value) as freight_value,
    sum(i.total_item_value) as total_item_value
from OLIST.CORE.fct_order_items i
join OLIST.CORE.fct_orders o
    on i.order_id = o.order_id
join OLIST.CORE.dim_products p
    on i.product_id = p.product_id
where o.is_delivered
group by 1, 2

select

    s.seller_city,

select purchase_month
from OLIST.MARTS.delivery_performance
where purchase_month is null
   or delivered_orders is null
   or measurable_orders is null
   or late_orders is null
   or missing_delivery_dates is null
   or measurable_orders + missing_delivery_dates <> delivered_orders
   or late_orders < 0
   or late_orders > measurable_orders
   or (
       measurable_orders > 0
       and (
           late_order_percentage is null
           or late_order_percentage <> round(
               100.0 * late_orders / measurable_orders, 2
           )
       )
   )
   or (
       measurable_orders = 0
       and late_order_percentage is not null
   )

union all

with expected as (
    select
        date_trunc(
            'month', o.order_purchase_timestamp
        )::date as purchase_month,
        count(distinct o.order_id) as delivered_orders,
        count(*) as delivered_items,
        sum(i.merchandise_value) as merchandise_value,
        sum(i.freight_value) as freight_value,
        sum(i.total_item_value) as total_item_value
    from OLIST.CORE.fct_orders o
    join OLIST.CORE.fct_order_items i
        on o.order_id = i.order_id
    where o.is_delivered
    group by 1
),

actual as (
    select *
    from OLIST.MARTS.monthly_delivered_sales
)

select
    coalesce(e.purchase_month, a.purchase_month) as purchase_month
from expected e
full outer join actual a
    on e.purchase_month = a.purchase_month
where e.purchase_month is null
   or a.purchase_month is null
   or e.delivered_orders is distinct from a.delivered_orders
   or e.delivered_items is distinct from a.delivered_items
   or e.merchandise_value is distinct from a.merchandise_value
   or e.freight_value is distinct from a.freight_value
   or e.total_item_value is distinct from a.total_item_value
   or a.total_item_value is distinct from
      (a.merchandise_value + a.freight_value)

where purchase_month is not null
group by purchase_month
having count(*) > 1

select
    purchase_month,
    customer_state,
    count(*) as row_count
from OLIST.MARTS.state_sales
group by purchase_month, customer_state
having count(*) > 1
    or purchase_month is null
    or customer_state is null

select merchandise_value
from OLIST.MARTS.product_performance
where merchandise_value is null

select product_id
from OLIST.MARTS.product_performance
where product_id is null

select
    product_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from OLIST.MARTS.product_performance
where product_id is not null
group by product_id
having count(*) > 1

select merchandise_value
from OLIST.MARTS.seller_performance
where merchandise_value is null

select seller_id
from OLIST.MARTS.seller_performance
where seller_id is null

select
    seller_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from OLIST.MARTS.seller_performance
where seller_id is not null
group by seller_id
having count(*) > 1

select
    count(*) as purchasing_customers,
    coalesce(
        sum(case when is_repeat_customer then 1 else 0 end),
        0
    ) as repeat_customers,
    round(
        100.0 * repeat_customers / nullif(count(*), 0),
        2
    ) as repeat_customer_percentage
from OLIST.MARTS.customer_purchase_summary
